canonical_title: Contextual HyperNetworks for Novel Feature Adaptation
authors: Ari S. Benjamin, David K. Lee, Bingni W. Brunton
paper_core_claims: Contextual HyperNetworks (CHNs) generate weights for new output features given a context set of examples.
CHNs enable incremental addition of new features to a trained model without full retraining.
The hypernetwork conditions on a context set (examples of the new feature) to produce appropriate classifier weights.
function_concept_used_by_paper: Functions (classifier weights) are generated by a hypernetwork conditioned on context. New functions are 'compiled' from example data rather than trained from scratch.
representation_or_carrier: Generated weight vectors for classifier layers, conditioned on context sets.
compiler_or_generator: The hypernetwork is the compiler: it takes a context set (examples of a new feature) and produces classifier weights for that feature.
interpreter_or_runtime: The base network uses the generated weights to classify inputs.
composition_rule: New features can be added incrementally; each generates its own weights via the hypernetwork.
state_or_effect_model: Context-dependent weight generation. No formal state or effect model.
validation_regime: Empirical: image classification with new classes added incrementally.
limitations_and_failure_boundaries: Limited to classifier head weights, not full network weights.
Generated weights are approximations of trained weights, not exact.
No formal specification or equivalence checking.
Context set quality affects generated weight quality.

ignition_gap_impacts.GAP-016: PARTIAL_SUPPORT: Hypernetwork as compiler for new features.
ignition_gap_impacts.GAP-019: WEAK_EVIDENCE: Incremental feature addition as versioning.

source_specific_reasoning: S120-012 provides evidence for N3 (Compiler): the hypernetwork compiles classifier weights from context examples. Incremental feature addition provides weak evidence for N9 (VersionedRegistry). However, scope is limited to classifier heads, no formal specification or equivalence.
comparison_reason: Hypernetwork for feature adaptation; confirms compiler pattern.
